description: This file defines the main view class for the JetBoy Android game. It includes a nested thread class responsible for game logic, rendering, handling of user input, and integration with the Android JetPlayer API for music and sound effects. The class manages game states, rendering backgrounds, sprites, asteroids, explosions, player controls, and synchronizing music cues with gameplay events.

classes.name: JetBoyView
classes.description: Main custom view class for the JetBoy game, handling rendering surface lifecycle, setting up the game thread, and providing interfaces for controls and updates.

classes.name: JetBoyThread
classes.description: Inner class extending Thread responsible for game logic, rendering, handling input events, and managing music cues via JetPlayer.

classes.name: GameEvent
classes.description: Base class for game-related events, storing event timestamp.

classes.name: KeyGameEvent
classes.description: Represents key input events, including keyCode, KeyEvent object, and whether it's a key-up or key-down.

classes.name: JetGameEvent
classes.description: Represents events from the JetPlayer, such as track cues and timer events, parameterized with player, segment, track, channel, controller, and value.

methods.name: initializeJetPlayer
methods.description: Sets up JetPlayer instance, loads the JET file, queues segments, and sets initial mute states.

methods.name: doDraw
methods.description: Main drawing method that delegates to state-specific drawing routines.

methods.name: doDrawRunning
methods.description: Draws the game scene including backgrounds, sprites, asteroids, explosion animations, and HUD.

methods.name: setInitialGameState
methods.description: Initializes or resets game variables for a new game session.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main game loop handling updates, rendering, and timing.

methods.name: updateGameState
methods.description: Processes input events and updates game objects accordingly.

methods.name: processKeyEvent
methods.description: Handles key events, updating context based on key presses or releases.

methods.name: updateLaser
methods.description: Manages laser firing state and mute flags for associated sound effects.

methods.name: updateAsteroids
methods.description: Moves asteroids, checks for collisions with laser, and replaces destroyed asteroids with explosions.

methods.name: updateExplosions
methods.description: Animates explosions and removes completed animations.

methods.name: processJetEvent
methods.description: Handles JET player events for triggering new asteroids and adjusting music based on hit streaks.

methods.name: doAsteroidCreation
methods.description: Spawns new asteroid objects at random Y positions.

methods.name: setRunning
methods.description: Controls thread execution, starts or stops the game loop.

methods.name: setGameState
methods.description: Updates game state, loading backgrounds and resetting timing if needed.

methods.name: doCountDown
methods.description: Updates countdown timer and sends updates to UI handler.
